parameters.query: SELECT t.id AS tid, u.id AS uid, u.name, cp.pin_hash, cp.failed_attempts, (cp.locked_until > NOW()) AS locked, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(cp.locked_until, '+00:00', '+05:30'), '%l:%i %p') AS locked_until, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('entry_id', e.id, 'team', x.name, 'team_code', x.code, 'division_id', e.division_id, 'division', d.name, 'status', e.status, 'paid_players', e.paid_players, 'reject_reason', e.reject_reason, 'squad', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entry_players ep WHERE ep.entry_id = e.id), 'waiting', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members w WHERE w.team_id = x.id AND w.status = 'PENDING'))) FROM tournament_entries e JOIN teams x ON x.id = e.team_id LEFT JOIN tournament_divisions d ON d.id = e.division_id WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.registered_by = u.id) AS teams FROM tournament_web_links l JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = l.tournament_id LEFT JOIN app_users u ON u.phone = $2 LEFT JOIN coach_web_pins cp ON cp.user_id = u.id WHERE l.slug = $1
